name: Create a provisional school of thought around a person, with candidate members
route: POST /api/schools/create-from-selection {name, description?, color?, thinker_ids[], kind: "provisional", project_note?, aliases?} → {ok, folder_id, slug, name, kind, added}; then per candidate not yet a thinker POST /api/thinker-folders/{folder_id}/recruit-author or POST /api/thinkers, and POST /api/schools/{folder_id}/candidates for those to review; the operator reconciles later with POST /api/schools/{folder_id}/reconcile {absorb|nest|keep}
cost_note: folder + memberships are DB writes; recruit-author queues a harvest (metered) only when asked
side_effects: a kind=provisional folder with the given thinkers as members (hidden from nothing; badged Provisional; reconcile affordance on its page); candidates in its review queue
gated_by: thinker_ids must exist in the Referee (resolve or create them first); name must be unique
yields: folder_id + slug (the school page), later merged_into_folder_id / parent_folder_ids after reconcile
